source: State Election Commission UP - Urban General Election 2023 declared results (NewWinnerList2023)
covers: All 762 ULBs of the 2023 general election (17 nagar nigam, 199 nagar palika parishad, 544 nagar panchayat; about 13,900 ward seats). Post dropdown: nagar nigam parshad, nagar palika parishad sadasya, nagar panchayat sadasya, plus mayor/chairperson.
how_to_scrape: ASP.NET postback: GET the page, post ctl00$ContentPlaceHolder1$DropDownList1 (8/10/12 = ward member of nigam/palika/panchayat) and ddlDistrict (0 = all), then page with the Next/Last pager. sec.up.nic.in (45.118.50.88) timed out from Germany AND from vpsin on 2026-11-10; the rows above come from the Wayback snapshot web.archive.org/web/20260712172252/https://sec.up.nic.in/site/NewWinnerList2023.aspx (first page only, fetched via vpsin). Retry the live site later; Wayback only has the default view.

source: State Election Commission Bihar - Nagarpalika General Election 2022 results, phase-wise (ResultP1 / ResultP2 / ResultP3), 2023 bye-election (ResultP4) and 2025 general/bye (Result2025)
covers: All municipal bodies that voted in 2022 (nagar nigam, nagar parishad, nagar panchayat; about 224+ ULBs, 38 districts). Each body only shows results on the page of the phase it voted in (Patna Nagar Nigam = phase 2; phase 1 page says 'counting in progress' for it). Posts: मुख्य पार्षद, उप मुख्य पार्षद, वार्ड पार्षद.

sample.name: रामजी चौधरी
sample.note: runner-up row, same table lists all candidates

how_to_scrape: ASP.NET cascading postbacks on ForPublic/ResultP{1,2,3,4}.aspx and Result2025.aspx: ddl_Post=3 (ward councillor) -> ddlDistrict (e.g. 28 = Patna) -> ddlNPType (1 nigam, 2 parishad, 3 panchayat) -> ddlPanchayat (body id, e.g. 310) -> ddlWard (required) -> btnFilter='Show'. One request per ward; winner row carries '(विजेता)'. No party field (Bihar ULB polls are non-party). Germany gets connection reset; works from vpsin.

source: State Election Commission Rajasthan - Winners & Runner-ups, Urban Local Body General Election (period 'SEP 2026')
covers: All ULBs of the 2026 ULB general election, 41 districts (e.g. Jaipur district: 19 bodies incl. Jaipur Nagar Nigam, Bagru, Chomu). Winner and runner-up for every ward. By-elections in the same form (Election=2).
how_to_scrape: ASP.NET postbacks: ElecType=2, Election=1, Period=61, DistrictDropDownList (e.g. 17 = Jaipur) -> PanchayatSamitiDropDownList (ULB id, e.g. 11472) returns the whole ULB table (Constituencydrpdwn defaults to --All--). One request per ULB. Related lists on ULB_Election_Reports.aspx: ViewWinnerPledgePDF.aspx, Chairperson Detail. Times out from Germany.

source: State Election Commission Haryana - gazette result notifications of elected Mayor/President and Members (PDF)
covers: 2025 (poll 02.03.2025): Municipal Corporations except Panipat (Faridabad, Gurugram, Manesar, Hisar, Karnal, Rohtak, Yamunanagar), 20 pp gazette; plus councils/committees notifications 2025/07/20250704818052458.pdf, 2025/07/202507041629123004.pdf, Panipat and Kalanaur. 2026 (poll 10.05.2026): MCs Ambala, Panchkula, Sonipat (2026/05/20260521432943498.pdf), committees (2026/05/202605211775525992.pdf), council Rewari (2026/05/20260521629385597.pdf), bye-elections. Together these cover all ~88 Haryana ULBs.
how_to_scrape: Download the PDFs listed on secharyana.gov.in (homepage 'Notification of Elected Candidates' links and the documents archive secharyana.gov.in/?p=6520). 2025 gazettes are Word-made: the English half has a clean text layer (pdftotext -layout; the Hindi half is Kruti Dev legacy font, skip it). 2026 notifications are scans with a poor OCR layer: re-OCR them.

source: Punjab SEC / LBPAMS public result API - Municipal General Election 2026
covers: 2,140 ward winners in 111 bodies (8 municipal corporations: Barnala, Bathinda, Abohar, Batala, Kapurthala, Moga, Pathankot, Mohali; plus municipal councils and nagar panchayats), poll 26.05.2026. NOT included: the 5 corporations elected Dec 2024 (Amritsar, Jalandhar, Ludhiana, Patiala, Phagwara) - still needs a source.
how_to_scrape: One POST with JSON {"stateMasterId":1,"districtMasterId":0,"assemblyMasterId":0,"electionTypeMasterIds":[4,5,6],"searchText":"","pageNumber":1,"pageSize":3000} returns all 2,140 rows (totalCount 2140, tested). Endpoint found in the Next.js page https://lbpams.punjab.gov.in/public-result/. Summary PDFs: sec.punjab.gov.in/en/result-municipal-election-2026/. Times out from Germany.

source: State Election Commission HP - DPMIS 'Elected Representatives' search
covers: All ULBs: level 002 = municipal councils and nagar panchayats, 003 = municipal corporations; terms 2026-2031 (51 municipalities polled 17.05.2026) and 2020-2025/2022-2027 (MC Shimla 2023 etc.). Example: Nahan (Sirmaur) 13 wards. Also PRIs.
how_to_scrape: ASP.NET postbacks: rbPriPost=002 (or 003), ddlPriTerm=2026-2031, ddlDis (e.g. 1310 Sirmaur), ddlPanch (body id, e.g. 1310999002 Nahan; '00' = all bodies of the district), rbPost=W, then btnShow='View List'. No party column. Older result PDFs on the En/index.html page (e.g. 'Notification- result mc shimla english.pdf'). Times out from Germany.

source: State Election Commission Uttarakhand - ULB result dashboard 2025
covers: All 100+ ULBs (11 nagar nigam, 46 palika parishad, 48 nagar panchayat; 1,324 member seats), poll 23.01.2025. BUT only party-wise win counts per district/body/ward are shown - no candidate names found.
how_to_scrape: Postbacks on the extensionless URL: ddlDistrict (e.g. 049) -> ddlUlb (e.g. 248430) -> ddlWard. Gives ward lists and party counts only. The server needs legacy TLS renegotiation (OpenSSL 3 refuses by default; worked with an OpenSSL config 'Options = UnsafeLegacyRenegotiation') - flag to the owner whether that is acceptable. For names: no official source found yet; check each nagar nigam site (nn<name>.uk.gov.in) or the Wikipedia 2025 Uttarakhand local elections pages (partial).

source: State Election Commission Jharkhand - Municipal (General) Election 2026 documents
covers: 48 ULBs (9 corporations, 20 nagar parishads, 19 nagar panchayats; 1,042 wards), poll 23.02.2026, count 27.02.2026. The 'Results' category is empty for 2026. 'NagarPalika Nirvachan Report 2026' (70 pp, 49 MB, image-only Corel PDF) lists mayor/chair and deputy per body; ward councillors not confirmed in it.

sample.content: table of district, body, chairperson/deputy names (image)

how_to_scrape: Site sends no intermediate cert: use a CA bundle with GlobalSign GCC R46 OV TLS CA 2025 (already in civic-officials/certs/, certs_trust.py). Postback MElection.aspx with BulletinTypeDropDown=3, ddlYear=2026, ddlCategory=0 to list files. No ward-councillor list found; news sites (indiatvnews.com ward-wise pages) have partial lists. Report needs OCR.

source: MyNeta (ADR) - Delhi MCD 2022 winners with affidavit data
covers: MCD 2022: 221 of 250 winners (those with analysed affidavits). Also myneta.info/mcd2012 (old 3-corporation MCD).

source: Wikipedia - 2021 Chandigarh Municipal Corporation election, ward-wise results
covers: MC Chandigarh, all 35 wards (poll 24.12.2021). Party labels as of results day (later defections not shown). Next election due Dec 2026.
how_to_scrape: GET ?action=raw and parse the 'Ward Wise Results' wikitable. Cross-check names with the MC's own list below.

source: Municipal Corporation Chandigarh - 'Team' page (mayor, councillors, nominated councillors)
covers: Current 35 elected councillors + 9 nominated (names only, no ward numbers, no party).
how_to_scrape: One GET via vpsin; names and roles are in card markup. Join to the Wikipedia ward table by name.

source: State Election Commission J&K - Municipal Elections 2018, result notification (list of duly elected members, all bodies)
covers: All ULBs of the 2018 poll (Jammu and Srinagar corporations, councils, committees; about 1,145 wards, some vacant). 86 pages with a text layer. HISTORICAL: these councils' terms ended Nov 2023 and no new ULB election has been held, so there are no sitting councillors now.
how_to_scrape: Plain http (https fails: missing intermediate cert). pdftotext -layout, split on 'Municipal Committee/Council/Corporation <name>' headers; names wrap over two lines. 2020 bye-elections: /MunicipalElectionsContent/mc_by-elections2020/.
